gp.text: The gross profit margin rate for 2024 increased slightly as the favorable effects of realized pricing more than offset unfavorable product and channel mix, lower sales volume and higher product costs.

opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text: Total operating expenses increased $38 million (7 percent) for 2024 compared to 2023. Operating expenses for 2024 included $13 million in incremental litigation costs associated with a trial that concluded in December of 2024, $13 million of investments in new product development and other growth initiatives, $7 million of business reorganization costs and $7 million of expenses from acquired operations. Reductions in volume and earnings-based expenses of $14 million for the year partially offset the increase in operating expenses. Investment in new product development in 2024 was $87 million, approximately 4 percent of sales.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: The effective income tax rate for 2024 was 18 percent, up 1 percentage point from 2023. The increase in 2024 was largely due to non-recurring tax benefits in 2023, variations in excess tax benefits from stock option exercises and the unfavorable effects of foreign earnings taxed at higher rates than the U.S.

The following table presents the components of net sales change by geographic region:

In 2024, net sales declined in all regions and in most end markets compared to 2023. Declines in global semiconductor markets drove sales lower in the Americas and Asia Pacific. Reduced project activity for automotive, electronics and e-mobility end markets, especially in China, furthered sales declines in Asia Pacific. opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text: Total operating expenses decreased $4 million (1 percent) for 2025 compared to 2024. Investment in new product development in 2025 was $82 million, approximately 4 percent of sales.

costs.heading: Operating Expenses
costs.text: Total operating expenses decreased $4 million (1 percent) for 2025 compared to 2024. Operating expenses for 2025 included $36 million of expenses from acquired operations and were mostly offset by a $14 million non-cash gain from the reduction in the fair value of acquisition-related contingent consideration recognized in the current year and $21 million of litigation and business reorganization costs from the prior year that did not repeat. nonop.heading: Interest & Other (Income) Expense
nonop.text: Interest expense for 2025 was flat compared to 2024. Other income decreased $3 million in 2025 compared to 2024 and included higher exchange losses on net liabilities of certain foreign operations of $8 million and decreased interest income of $8 million. Partially offsetting these items were a $5 million gain in 2025 from the sale of a former manufacturing and distribution facility in Switzerland and $2 million of favorable market valuation changes on investments held to fund certain retirement benefits.

tax.heading: Income Taxes

Changes in receivables were consistent with higher sales levels. Reductions to inventory levels in 2025 as the result of an inventory reduction program were offset by the effect of acquired inventory on working capital, but improved inventory turnover in 2025. The current ratio decreased in 2025 in line with the changes in working capital.

intro.text: Graco Inc., together with its subsidiaries (“Graco,” “us,” “we,” or “our Company”), is a multi-national manufacturing company. We supply technology and expertise for the management of fluids and coatings in industrial and commercial applications. We design, manufacture and market systems and equipment used to move, measure, mix, control, dispense and spray fluid and powder materials. Our equipment is used in manufacturing, processing, construction and maintenance industries. Graco is a Minnesota corporation and was incorporated in 1926.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
